verdict.rationale:
Foreloop ships event-driven background automation: PR pushes automatically trigger reviews with scores/findings without manual invocation, and the feedback-widget pipeline lets an agent autonomously read submissions, fill intentions, and propose tasks. The CLI/MCP explicitly supports being run from cron or coding agents, hinting at scheduled/background use, but there's no documented general-purpose automation/scheduling framework beyond these two built-in flows.
missing for 10: explicit user-configurable automation/scheduling UI, evidence of custom trigger definitions beyond PR push and feedback submission, independent confirmation of cron-based usage in practice.
